decision.observation: Car at 0 mph, gear 1, red X lit, sitting on the grass left of the lane; the tarmac runs up-screen to its right with a row of coloured barrels along the lane's left edge, a boulder and puddles further up. The car looks halted against the verge greenery rather than moving.
decision.hypothesis: Forward again ended in a verge pin. A 1s plain reverse should pull it back off the obstruction and, with luck, roll it toward the lane side before another steered forward.
